home.heroEyebrow: Umukuni wa Fistula na Ifya Kupwisha pa Kufyalwa mu Zambia
home.heroTitle: Umukashi bonse afwa kupwaisha pa kufyalwa, kubwino bwa lubilo, ukushingwa na uluse.
home.heroSubtitle: FCIAZ ni umukuni wakwe, ucitapo sana pa kubomya ifya kupwaisha pa kufyalwa mu Zambia — pa kutetekela, imisangano, ukuyambitsa na ifya kupendulula.
home.stat2Label: Yapangwa na ba doctor ba Zambia na batungulwa ba mimoneke
home.stat3Label: Ba Executive Committee abacita pa lubilo lwa mission
home.pillarsSubheading: Imisangano itatu icitika pa kwingilamo kwa FCIAZ.
home.pillarAdvocacyDescription: Tulecitapo kuli balongolwa, ba church, balongolwa ba cicunucuno, na bafyashi kuti ukubomya kwa banakashi kukabe cintu cikalamba.
home.pillarTreatmentDescription: Tupatila abanakashi kuti bafikapo pa kubwino bwa fistula repair, tulepatila ba doctor mu cipatala, no kwingilamo ifyabwino ifi bakwata.
home.pillarIntegrationDescription: Tulepatila pa physiotherapy, counselling, na ifya kwingilamo pa kubwezelela abanamayo kubumi bwabwino.
home.missionBody: Ukuba ilyashi likulu mu Zambia pa kubomya fistula na ifya kupwaisha pa kufyalwa — pa kutetekela, abalundwe, ifya kuyiisha, imisangano yabwino, ukuyambitsa na ifya kupendulula.
home.visionBody: Zambia umo umukashi tafwa kupwaisha pa kufyalwa, kabili umukashi yense wafwa kubomya, ukushingwa, na ubumi bwabwino.
home.boardSnapshotSubheading: Ba doctor na batungulwa ba FCIAZ.
home.ctaHeading: Imeni pamo na banakashi ba Zambia
home.ctaBody: Nokutila mwatupa money, mwakaba abasambi, mwalembapo na balundwe, muli kutatukwasheni kucita pa banamayo.

about.title: Ifya kuli kwa FCIAZ
about.subtitle: Umukuni wa Zambia uwa kubomya fistula na ifya kupwaisha pa kufyalwa.
about.historyBody: FCIAZ yapangwa mu 2026 na ba doctor ba Zambia, ba surgeon, na batungulwa ba mimoneke pa kuti fistula na ifya kupwaisha pa kufyalwa ifyalefwa kucitwa ku banakashi bafwa ifya kubomya ifya tabafwa. Umukuni uyu wapangwa kucita ilyashi pa Zambia yonse.
about.missionBody: Ukuba ilyashi likulu mu Zambia pa kubomya fistula na ifya kupwaisha pa kufyalwa — pa kutetekela, abalundwe, ifya kuyiisha, imisangano yabwino, ukuyambitsa na ifya kupendulula.
about.visionBody: Zambia umo umukashi tafwa kupwaisha pa kufyalwa, kabili umukashi yense wafwa kubomya, ukushingwa, na ubumi bwabwino.
about.valueDignityDescription: Tuleika pa lubilo ululashi lwa banamayo mu fyonse ifya tulecita.
about.valueIntegrityDescription: Ukucita ifya kwingilamo ifyabwino no kubomya ifya twafwa.
about.valueEquityDescription: Tufikapo ku banakashi ba mu malipoti, nokuba tabafwa money.
about.valueEvidenceDescription: Imisangano iyi shina mu fya ba doctor na fya kuyiisha.
about.valuePartnershipDescription: Tucita pamo na bafyashi, church, balongolwa ba mimoneke.
about.registrationBody: FCIAZ iliko pa kusendama pa NGO Act ya Zambia. Ifya kusendama na Registrar, ZRA na PACRA iliko pa kubomya.

board.kasandaBio: Mwine lubilo. Doctor wa mimoneke wa banakashi mu Zambia.
board.kaundaBio: Secretary General. Alongolola ifya kusendama na komiti ya FCIAZ.
board.temboBio: Publicity Secretary. Alongolola ifya kuyiisha, ukutetekela na ilyashi lya FCIAZ.
board.kawimbeBio: Membala wa komiti. Aletapo ifya kubomya pa kubingisha fistula.
board.zuluBio: Membala wa komiti. Alongolola ifya kwingilamo pa bafyashi.

whatWeDo.title: Ifya tulecita
whatWeDo.subtitle: FCIAZ icita pa misango itatu. Yense yafwa.
whatWeDo.advocacyTagline: Ifya kubomya ifwa kwingilamo kwa Zambia.
whatWeDo.advocacyBody: Tucita pamo na bafyashi, ba church, ba professional bodies, na government kuti fistula ikabe pa agenda ya Zambia.
whatWeDo.advocacyPoint1: Awareness campaigns pa lubilo lwa 23 May (International Day to End Obstetric Fistula).
whatWeDo.advocacyPoint2: Ukuyaisa ku Ministry of Health, UTH, OGSZ, Medical Council na abalundwe bumbi.
whatWeDo.advocacyPoint3: Policy briefs, press releases, na media kit.
whatWeDo.advocacyPoint4: Ifya kuyiisha na ba chief, ba church, na banakashi.
whatWeDo.treatmentTagline: Banakashi bafikapo pa kubomya kwa fistula.
whatWeDo.treatmentBody: Tucita pamo na ba doctor na ba cipatala kwingilamo fistula repair.
whatWeDo.treatmentPoint1: Ifya kupatila ku UTH Women and Newborn Hospital.
whatWeDo.treatmentPoint2: Ifya kuyiisha ba doctor na ba nurse.
whatWeDo.treatmentPoint3: Ifya kupendulula ifya kubomya mu cipatala.
whatWeDo.treatmentPoint4: Ifya kupatila cipatala pa ifya kwingilamo.
whatWeDo.integrationBody: Ukuyambitsa ni cintu icibomya ukubwezelela mu bumi bwabwino.
whatWeDo.integrationPoint2: Counselling ya banamayo na fyashi yabo.
whatWeDo.integrationPoint3: Ifya kuyiisha pa business na kubomya money.
whatWeDo.integrationPoint4: Faces of Hope Campaign — peer support.
whatWeDo.researchBody: Tucita pamo na universities ku kupendulula ifya fistula.
whatWeDo.researchPoint1: Ifya kucita pamo na LMMU, UNZA, na Copperbelt University.
whatWeDo.researchPoint3: Ifya kupatila data kuli Ministry of Health.

getInvolved.title: Pati mu citenipo
getInvolved.subtitle: Ifya kupatila FCIAZ — pa kuli, pa fyashi, noku organization.
getInvolved.donateBody: Money yenu iyakuyiisha ifya fistula, surgical supplies, na reintegration.
getInvolved.volunteerBody: Abasambi batupatila pa events, translations, photography, na imisango.
getInvolved.partnerBody: Tulefwaya balundwe ba NGOs, ba cipatala, professional bodies, universities, na media.
getInvolved.advocateBody: Patikeni ifya kwisa kwa benu pa social media, na kulongolola ifya kuyiisha mu fyashi yenu.
getInvolved.campaignFacesBody: Ifya kubwezelela dignity kuli banakashi bafyala fistula — pa story (pa consent), videos, na ifya kubomya.
getInvolved.campaignDayTitle: Lubilo lwa 23 May — International Day to End Obstetric Fistula
getInvolved.campaignDayBody: Pa 23 May, FCIAZ icita pamo na nseke yonse. Mutafweni apa pa events na media.

donate.title: Tupatileni pa FCIAZ
donate.subtitle: Money yenu yonse — nokuba yacepa — itwakuyiisha ifya kupatila banakashi ba Zambia.
donate.sectionBankBody: Sengeni money mu account ya FCIAZ. Tutumineni slip ya deposit pa {email}.
donate.mtnStep1: Dial *303# (kapena *165#) pa MTN yenu, kapena iseni mu MoMo app.
donate.airtelStep1: Dial *115# pa Airtel yenu, kapena iseni mu Airtel Money app.
donate.airtelStep3: Ingishe nambala ya FCIAZ Airtel Money.
donate.zamtelStep1: Dial Zamtel Money USSD code pa Zamtel yenu, kapena iseni mu Zamtel Money app.
donate.zamtelStep3: Ingishe nambala ya FCIAZ Zamtel Money.
donate.thankYouBody: Money yenu itucitisha ifya kubomya banakashi ba Zambia.
donate.transparencyBody: FCIAZ ilomba ku citapo money pa kubomya. Annual statements yafwa kupwaikapo.
